lines.en: I crawl sideways across the stone ledge.
Eight legs tap the ground together.

lines.zh: 我的壳在雾里发出响声。
lines.en: My shell rings in the fog.
I turn slowly in your direction.
I walk along the bastion wall.
I raise a great claw a little.
I shift step by step, heavy.
My legs crush the gravel.
I squeeze under the doorway.

lines.zh: 我的八条腿一节节碾过石板。
lines.en: My eight legs grind over the flagstones.
I crouch at the center of the bastion.
Frost lies on my shell.
My great claws open and shut.
I listen for the steps of besiegers.
Fog seeps through the bastion's cracks.
I slowly draw in a leg.

lines.zh: 这只蟹钳把王座刮得发亮。
lines.en: These claws have polished the throne smooth.
I'm in no hurry for anything.

lines.zh: 我的壳底下有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves under my shell.
I raise a claw and clack it.
My giant claw rests on the stone stair.

lines.zh: 我在等一个够大的猎物。
lines.en: I wait for prey big enough.
The stones of the bastion remember me.
I settle my weight to the floor.
A low sound comes from inside my shell.
I open my claws again.
You've walked into my bastion.
I raise a claw slowly.
You're smaller than the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把你从脚看到头。
lines.en: I look you over from feet to head.
You stand on my ground.

lines.zh: 我的壳挡得住你的武器。
lines.en: My shell will stop your weapon.

lines.zh: 我在量你的步子有多宽。
lines.en: I measure how wide you step.
You step further in.

lines.zh: 我转了一下身体，正对你。
lines.en: I turn my body square to you.
This doorway only fits me.
I remember all who came.
You shouldn't touch my things.

lines.zh: 一道白痕留在我的甲壳上。
lines.en: A white scar stays on my carapace.

lines.zh: 这一下在我壳上留了坑。
lines.en: That left a dent in my shell.
I give half an inch, slowly.
My limbs tremble under my shell.
This crack is no wound.
I raise my claws higher.
I know which side you came from.
I settle my weight again.
Frost falls from my shell.

lines.zh: 甲壳堡垒里，这只大蟹是我。
lines.en: In the chitin bastion, this giant crab is me.
I sweep the carrion aside.
I nudge it with a claw.

lines.zh: 我找不到你说的那样东西。
lines.en: I cannot find what you describe.

lines.zh: 我蟹壳底下，是堡垒的砖。
lines.en: Bastion brick grows under my shell.
I pin it under a claw.
This buys nothing.
That is not enough to fill a shell gap.
I give it one slow look.
Take it; of no use to me.

lines.zh: 我的注意力回到你身上。
lines.en: My attention returns to you.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬得像堡垒的石墙。
lines.en: My shell is as hard as the bastion wall.
You hit my shell and slide off.
I block with a claw.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，螃蟹的壳顶着你。
lines.en: You have backed to the wall; my crab shell presses.
My legs settle beside your feet.
The stone sounds under my weight.
I turn and block the door.

lines.zh: 我这壳，比要塞的门还厚。
lines.en: This shell is thicker than a bastion door.
I steady my body.
You can't get around this shell.
Another shell emerges from the dark.
Our claws knock together.
Its shell is thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起守住这座堡垒。
lines.en: We hold this bastion together.

lines.zh: 我们在石台上并排伏着。
lines.en: We crouch side by side on the ledge.
Our breathing stirs the fog.
In this moment, the bastion is quiet.

lines.zh: 两道雾里的呼吸，合在一起。
lines.en: Two breaths in the fog become one.
Tomorrow we each keep a stretch of wall.
The fog thins; we remain.
I lift it in a claw.
I pinch a small piece with my claw tip.
I press it under my shell.
I bend it; it doesn't break.
I toss it to the bastion's corner.
It rolls between my legs.
I watch it, then look away.
I tuck this under my shell.
My grip left a mark on it.
It crumbles to dust in my claw.
You've entered my bastion.
Fine, you're the one.
I raise both claws.
My legs have set.
The door is there; you won't pass.
A giant crab shell filling the bastion.

lines.zh: 蟹壳压下去，石地都沉了。
lines.en: My shell sinks and the stone floor gives.
This bastion has one door.
You're already in my eyes.
You're against the wall; good.
My claws are open wide.
I've waited long for this.

lines.zh: 我横着爬过石台，八条腿敲着地。
lines.en: I crawl sideways over the slab, eight legs drumming.
I squeeze forward with my shell.
One of my legs steps out first.
You're inside my gate.
I aim my claws at you.

lines.zh: 我把两只钳都抬起来了。
lines.en: I raise both claws.
I shift closer step by step.
The shadow of my claw stays on you.

lines.zh: 两只钳一前一后夹着你。
lines.en: Two claws close on you, front and back.
The gap narrows bit by bit.
I block half the wall.
You're in the corner.
No hurry; I'm heavier.
You stepped on gravel.
My claws rise to shoulder height.
This will be hard to dodge.
Your breath grows rough.
The fog hides me well.
I shift one more step.
The moment has ripened.
I swing two legs across.
You look at the gate; it's shut.
I press my shell to the wall.

lines.zh: 我的钳一直对着你，没松过。
lines.en: My claw has never left you.
One more shift and I'll have you.
I don't chase; I block.
My claw snaps down.
The other claw arrives too.
You're caught and can't pull free.
I ram and you hit the wall.
My leg pins your foot.
The shell strikes with a dull sound.
A crack opens in the floor.
I wrench my claw and throw you off.

lines.zh: 我的钳合上，石墙也裂了。
lines.en: My claw snaps shut and the wall cracks.
I turn my body slowly.
My claws still open and close.
The fog fills with stone chips.

lines.zh: 我把整个壳立起来砸下。
lines.en: I rear my whole shell up and slam down.
You still have strength to stand.

lines.zh: 我从堡垒的暗处爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the bastion's dark.
The ledge shuddered once.
Chorvax, here.
My shell emerges from the fog.
I raise two great claws slowly.

lines.zh: 我的腿一条条压在地上。
lines.en: My legs press down one by one.

lines.zh: 堡垒的墙记得我的重量。
lines.en: The bastion walls know my weight.
I've squeezed through the doorway.
I've come to see who entered.
The fog here is mine.
I block the passage side-on.

lines.zh: 我从堡垒的阴影里挪出来。
lines.en: I shift out of the bastion's shadow.
My claw taps the floor.

lines.zh: 没有东西能从我身后过。
lines.en: Nothing passes behind me.
I raise both great claws.
I keep this bastion.
Since I'm here, I stay.
Frost falls from the cracks.
I lower my body, ready.
Let me see how big you are.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的壳，热气钻进来。
lines.en: Fire roasts my shell and heat gets inside.

lines.zh: 我从石台上翻下去，摔得很重。
lines.en: I tip off the ledge and land hard.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的壳缝，我动不了了。
lines.en: Water fills my shell's seams and I can't move.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的壳掀开一角。
lines.en: The blast pries up a corner of my shell.

lines.zh: 一枚投射物嵌进我的壳里。
lines.en: A projectile lodges in my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力绕过壳，钻进肉里。
lines.en: The force skirts my shell into my flesh.
Too long hungry, my claws waver.

lines.zh: 雷打在石台上，我整具壳都在震。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ledge and my whole shell shakes.
There are no walls here to hold.
